suspicions.claim: The private_email post_dump hook unconditionally removes the email field for all users including the current user, so even the authenticated user cannot see their own email address.
suspicions.trigger: Log in as any user (e.g., POST /api/tokens with HTTP Basic auth for alice/doppel-pass), then GET /api/me with Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. Read back the JSON response and verify that the 'email' field is missing.
suspicions.evidence: Probes for s1 (alice) and s6 (alice) show GET /api/me returned email in base but email absent in head.

suspicions.claim: The private_email hook removes the email field from all user representations in collections, so endpoints returning lists of users no longer include email addresses for any user.
suspicions.trigger: Log in as any user, then GET /api/users with Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. Read back the JSON response and verify that objects in the 'data' array lack an 'email' field.
suspicions.evidence: Probe for s2 (bob) shows GET /api/users returned users with email in base but email absent in head.

suspicions.claim: The private_email hook removes the email field when retrieving a specific user by ID or username, so even the authenticated user cannot view another user's email (which is intended) but also cannot view their own email via these routes.
suspicions.trigger: Log in as alice, then GET /api/users/1 with Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. Read back the JSON response and verify that the 'email' field is missing.
suspicions.evidence: Probe for s3 (carol) shows GET /api/users/1 returned email in base but email absent in head.

suspicions.claim: The private_email hook removes the email field from the author object nested in post responses, so post endpoints no longer include the author's email address.
suspicions.trigger: Log in as any user, then GET /api/posts with Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. Read back the JSON response and verify that objects in the 'data' array have an 'author' object without an 'email' field.
suspicions.evidence: Probes for s4 (dave) and probe_s4 show GET /api/posts returned posts with author.email in base but author.email absent in head.

suspicions.claim: The private_email hook removes the email field from user objects in followers/following collections, so those endpoints no longer include email addresses.
suspicions.trigger: Log in as any user, then GET /api/users/1/followers with Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. Read back the JSON response and verify that objects in the 'data' array lack an 'email' field.
suspicions.evidence: Probe for s5 (erin) shows GET /api/users/1/followers returned users with email in base but email absent in head.

suspicions.claim: The private_email hook removes the email field from user objects returned by the user posts endpoint, so that endpoint no longer includes the author's email.
suspicions.trigger: Log in as any user, then GET /api/users/1/posts with Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. Read back the JSON response and verify that the 'author' object in each post lacks an 'email' field.
suspicions.evidence: Probe for s6 shows GET /api/users/1/posts returned posts with author.email in base but author.email absent in head.
